Curve of constant width.question: What do you know about In geometry, a curve of constant width?
Curve of constant width.answer: a simple closed curve in the plane whose width (the distance between parallel supporting lines) is the same in all direc
Curve of constant width.fact: In geometry, a curve of constant width is a simple closed curve in the plane whose width (the distance between parallel supporting lines) is the same in all directions. The shape bounded by a curve of constant width is a body of constant width or an orbiform, the name given to these shapes by Leonhard Euler.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: Standard examples are the circle and the _____ triangle
Curve of constant width.fact: Standard examples are the circle and the Reuleaux triangle. By Barbier's theorem, the body's perimeter is exactly π times its width, but its area depends on its shape, with the Reuleaux triangle having the smallest possible area for its width and the circle the largest.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: Although the _____ triangle is not smooth, curves of constant width can always be approximated arbitrarily closely by smooth curves of the same constant width
Curve of constant width.fact: By Barbier's theorem, the body's perimeter is exactly π times its width, but its area depends on its shape, with the Reuleaux triangle having the smallest possible area for its width and the circle the largest. Although the Reuleaux triangle is not smooth, curves of constant width can always be approximated arbitrarily closely by smooth curves of the same constant width.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: Another application of curves of constant width is for coinage shapes, where regular _____ polygons are a common choice
Curve of constant width.fact: Although the Reuleaux triangle is not smooth, curves of constant width can always be approximated arbitrarily closely by smooth curves of the same constant width. Another application of curves of constant width is for coinage shapes, where regular Reuleaux polygons are a common choice.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: Curves of constant width have been generalized in several ways to higher dimensions and to non-_____ geometry
Curve of constant width.fact: Curves of constant width have been generalized in several ways to higher dimensions and to non-Euclidean geometry. The Euclidean distance between these two lines is the width of the curve in that direction, and a curve has constant width if this distance is the same for all directions of lines.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: A standard example is the _____ triangle, the intersection of three circles, each centered where the other two circles cross
Curve of constant width.fact: A standard example is the Reuleaux triangle, the intersection of three circles, each centered where the other two circles cross.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: For instance, this construction generates a _____ triangle from an equilateral triangle
Curve of constant width.fact: For instance, this construction generates a Reuleaux triangle from an equilateral triangle. Some irregular polygons also generate Reuleaux polygons.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: Some irregular polygons also generate _____ polygons
Curve of constant width.fact: For instance, this construction generates a Reuleaux triangle from an equilateral triangle. Some irregular polygons also generate Reuleaux polygons.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: Given any two bodies of constant width, their _____ sum forms another body of constant width
Curve of constant width.fact: Given any two bodies of constant width, their Minkowski sum forms another body of constant width. A generalization of Minkowski sums to the sums of support functions of hedgehogs produces a curve of constant width from the sum of a projective hedgehog and a circle, whenever the result is a convex curve.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: By the isoperimetric inequality and _____'s theorem, the circle has the maximum area of any curve of given constant width
Curve of constant width.fact: Barbier's theorem asserts that the perimeter of any curve of constant width is equal to the width multiplied by π {\displaystyle \pi }. By the isoperimetric inequality and Barbier's theorem, the circle has the maximum area of any curve of given constant width.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: Every proper superset of a body of constant width has strictly greater diameter, and every _____ set with this property is a body of constant width
Curve of constant width.fact: Every proper superset of a body of constant width has strictly greater diameter, and every Euclidean set with this property is a body of constant width.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: A convex body has constant width if and only if the _____ sum of the body and its 180° rotation is a circular disk; if so, the width of the body is the radius of the disk
Curve of constant width.fact: A convex body has constant width if and only if the Minkowski sum of the body and its 180° rotation is a circular disk; if so, the width of the body is the radius of the disk.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: For instance the _____ 20p and 50p coins are Reuleaux heptagons, and the Canadian loonie is a Reuleaux 11-gon
Curve of constant width.fact: For instance the British 20p and 50p coins are Reuleaux heptagons, and the Canadian loonie is a Reuleaux 11-gon.

Curve of constant width.subject: Environment & Ecology
Curve of constant width.question: The three-dimensional analog of a _____ triangle, the Reuleaux tetrahedron, does not have constant width, but minor changes to it produce the Meissner bodies, which do
Curve of constant width.fact: The three-dimensional analog of a Reuleaux triangle, the Reuleaux tetrahedron, does not have constant width, but minor changes to it produce the Meissner bodies, which do.
